Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: NATURAL GAS PROCESSING PLANT
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.272640, -80.303582 (Approximated from ZIP)
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** 7/27/2013- SATURDAY, GUESTS AND I WERE OUTSIDE ADMIRING THE FLARES THAT HAVE BEEN CONTINUOUSLY BURNING FOR THE LAST FEW DAYS AT THE MARK WEST CRYOGENIC PLANT, WHEN A STRONG SMELL OF CHEMICALS AND SULFUR BLEW BY. THE FLARES WERE VERY LARGE, BOTH STACKS BURNING (NO BLACK SMOKE NOTED AT THIS TIME). RECENTLY WITHIN THE LAST WEEK OR SO THE NOISE DISRUPTION HAS BECOME DISTINCTLY MORE NOTICEABLE AND IS AFFECTING OUR ACTIVITIES OF DAILY LIVING. 7/7/28/2013, SUNDAY AS I AWOKE AND TURNED ON FAUCET I WAS OVERCOME WITH A STRONG SMELL OF SULFUR, WHICH AFTER APPROXIMATELY 20-30 SEC OF WATER RUNNING THE SMELL DISSIPATED.
